violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CFM ARRIVED PRIOR TO THE END OF THE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: The highest temperature observed at the handwashing sink was 73°F.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Other Chemical Proper Use
violations.observation: The operator is using a lactic acid based sanitizer. Dispenser was not producing chemical at an appropriate concentration.
violations.corrective_action: If a chemical sanitizer other than chlorine, iodine, or quaternary ammonium compound is used it shall be applied in accordance with the manufacturer's use directions included in the labeling. PIC MANUALLY MIXED SANITIZER WITH WATER.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Manual Wash Water Temperature
violations.observation: The highest temperature of the water at the 3 comp sink was observed at 74°F.
violations.corrective_action: The temperature of the wash solution for manual warewashing machine must be no less than 110F or the temperature specified on the cleaning agent manufacturer's label instructions.
